---
title: "Prepare IHME burden and trial classification tables"
author: "Sanyu Takirambudde"
date: "2026-11-22"
output: github_document
params:
  output_dir: "data/tidy"
  trial_start_year: 2010
  trial_end_year: 2023
  allow_proposed: true
---

This document produces four RDS tables for the project. Rerunning replaces these four outputs but doesn't edit the raw data, proposed mappings, or main review CSV.

**Trial classifications are provisional when `allow_proposed` is true.** 

The current setting includes pending proposed matches as well as approved matches.
Set it to `false` in the header to use approved mappings only. 

## 1. Load functions and choose settings

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
source("source/tidy_gbd.R")
source("source/mesh_gbd_crosswalk.R")

output_dir = params$output_dir
trial_start_year = params$trial_start_year
trial_end_year = params$trial_end_year
allow_proposed = params$allow_proposed
```

## 2. Read the GBD hierarchy and category names

```{r categories}
hierarchy = read_csv(
  "data/crosswalk/gbd_2023_cause_hierarchy.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

analysis_categories = gbd_targets(hierarchy) |>
  filter(!is.na(analysis_cause_id)) |>
  distinct(analysis_cause_id, analysis_cause)
```

The same category IDs are used for burden and trials. The three original injury categories are combined into Injuries. Tthe other Level 2 categories stay separate.

## 3. Prepare country DALYs

```{r country-dalys}
country_paths = list.files(
  "data", pattern = "^IHME-GBD_[0-9]{4}.*[.]csv$", full.names = TRUE
)

gbd_countries = tidy_gbd_countries(country_paths)

country_counts = gbd_countries |> count(iso3, year)

daly_df = summarize_gbd_analysis(gbd_countries) |>
  left_join(analysis_categories, by = "analysis_cause") |>
  relocate(analysis_cause_id, .before = analysis_cause) |>
  arrange(iso3, year, analysis_cause_id)
```

`daly_df` has one row per country/territory × year × analysis cause. The input is DALY **Number**, both sexes, all ages, age-standardized: values are DALYs, not thousands or rates. `daly_share` is a disease's share of the included DALYs **within that country and year**. It's not a country's share of global burden for that disease. I summed the injury point estimates. I didn't add uncertainty-interval endpoints as these aggregated outputs therefore don't include uncertainty intervals.

## 4. Prepare income-group DALYs

```{r income-dalys}
income_path = "data/IHME-GBD_world-bank-income-groups.csv"
income_source = read_gbd(income_path)
income_counts = income_source |> count(location, year)

daly_income_df = tidy_gbd_income(income_path) |>
  left_join(analysis_categories, by = "analysis_cause") |>
  relocate(analysis_cause_id, .before = analysis_cause) |>
  arrange(income_group, year, analysis_cause_id)
```

`daly_income_df` uses the income-group aggregates supplied by IHME. Shares are within each income group and year.

## 5. Read the crosswalk review and classify trials

```{r trial-classification}
studies = read_rds("data/studies.rds")
browse = read_rds("data/browse_conditions.rds")
review = read_csv(
  "data/crosswalk/mesh_gbd_review.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    review_decision = col_character(),
    reviewed_gbd_cause_id = col_integer(),
    reviewer = col_character(), review_note = col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
cohort = crosswalk_cohort(studies, trial_start_year, trial_end_year)

result = apply_mesh_crosswalk(
  browse, cohort, review, hierarchy, allow_proposed = allow_proposed
)

# Keep coverage information alongside the classification outputs.
trial_context = result$trial_audit |>
  mutate(start_year = as.integer(format(start_date, "%Y")))

trial_terms_df = result$term_evidence |>
  select(nct_id, mesh_term, analysis_cause_id, analysis_cause,
         resolved_cause_id, resolved_cause_name, mapping_status,
         review_decision, reviewer, review_note) |>
  left_join(trial_context, by = "nct_id") |>
  mutate(proposed_mappings_allowed = allow_proposed) |>
  arrange(nct_id, mesh_term)

trial_cause_df = result$trial_causes |>
  left_join(trial_context, by = "nct_id") |>
  mutate(
    classification_status = if_else(
      all_terms_reviewed, "reviewed", "provisional"
    ),
    proposed_mappings_allowed = allow_proposed
  ) |>
  arrange(nct_id, analysis_cause_id)
```

`trial_terms_df` has one row per trial × MeSH term, including terms without a category.

`trial_cause_df` has one row per trial × assigned analysis cause. Multiple terms
supporting the same category don't create extra rows. A trial can count once in each of several categories. Countries are not joined yet, so these aren't trial-country tables.

`classification_status = reviewed` applies to the terms supporting that category; other terms on the same trial may remain unresolved. Check `coverage_status` too.

Trials with no MeSH terms are absent from `trial_terms_df`. 
Trials with no mapped categories are absent from `trial_cause_df`. 
Neither of these dataframes represents the full cohort denominator. 
We should use the cohort and audit when calculating coverage.

## 6. Check and summarize the outputs

```{r checks}
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(daly_df$analysis_cause_id),
  !anyNA(daly_income_df$analysis_cause_id),
  !anyNA(daly_income_df$income_group),
  !anyDuplicated(daly_df[c("iso3", "year", "analysis_cause_id")]),
  !anyDuplicated(daly_income_df[c("income_group", "year", "analysis_cause_id")]),
  !anyDuplicated(trial_terms_df[c("nct_id", "mesh_term")]),
  !anyDuplicated(trial_cause_df[c("nct_id", "analysis_cause_id")]),
  all(trial_cause_df$analysis_cause_id %in% daly_df$analysis_cause_id),
  nrow(result$trial_audit) == nrow(cohort)
)

country_shares = daly_df |>
  group_by(iso3, year) |>
  summarize(n_causes = n(), total = sum(daly_share), .groups = "drop")

income_shares = daly_income_df |>
  group_by(income_group, year) |>
  summarize(n_causes = n(), total = sum(daly_share), .groups = "drop")

result$trial_audit |>
  count(coverage_status, name = "n_trials") |>
  mutate(percent = round(100 * n_trials / sum(n_trials), 1)) |>
  knitr::kable()

trial_terms_df |> 
  count(mapping_status) |> 
  knitr::kable()

tibble(
  file = 
    c("daly.rds", "daly_income.rds", "trial_terms.rds", "trial_cause.rds"),
  rows = 
    c(nrow(daly_df), nrow(daly_income_df), nrow(trial_terms_df), nrow(trial_cause_df))
) |> 
  knitr::kable()
```

These checks detect structural problems. The disease burden files cover more years than the trial cohort. We need to restrict both to an agreed-upon comparison period when building the analysis.

## 7. Save the four tables

```{r save}
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_rds(daly_df, file.path(output_dir, "daly.rds"), compress = "gz")

write_rds(daly_income_df, file.path(output_dir, "daly_income.rds"), compress = "gz")

write_rds(trial_terms_df, file.path(output_dir, "trial_terms.rds"), compress = "gz")

write_rds(trial_cause_df, file.path(output_dir, "trial_cause.rds"), compress = "gz")
```

The four files are saved under `data/tidy/`.
To load a saved table later, use `read_rds("data/tidy/daly.rds")`.
